description: Vue cleanups read live values (cleanupReadsPrevious is off for Vue; docs/design/REACTIVITY-ALIASING.md, cross-framework matrix): a watchEffect's onWatcherCleanup and a watch callback's onCleanup run before the next run and read the writes that re-run it, through a deep ref's proxy and a computed value too; at unmount a child's onBeforeUnmount, onUnmounted and watcher cleanup read its last render's props, and live values through them. Svelte reads the values before the flush instead (case teardown-proxy). Vue 3.5.43 in Chromium; the native model agreed before, a regression case
